'''Shaher Momani''' is a Jordanian distinguished professor of [[applied mathematics]] and one of the top ten  scientists in the world in the field of [[fractional calculus]] according to [[Web of Science]] several times between 2009 and 2013. He was selected as one of the world's most influential scientific minds according to [[Thomson Reuters]] in 2014 and 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pharmacy.umich.edu/sites/default/files/worlds-most-influential-scientific-minds-2014.pdf|title=list of The World's Most Influential Scientific Minds in 2014|website=Pharmacy.umich.edu|accessdate=2 March 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://ece.nl/wp-content/uploads/Thomson-Reuters-2015.pdf |title=Archived copy |website=ece.nl |access-date=14 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160308215249/http://ece.nl/wp-content/uploads/Thomson-Reuters-2015.pdf |archive-date=8 March 2016 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Momani was also selected by Thomson Reuters as one of the highly cited researchers between 2014 and 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://hcr.clarivate.com/|title=Highly Cited Researchers - The Most Influential Scientific Minds|website=Hcr.clarivate.com|accessdate=2 March 2019|archive-date=20 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190220122703/https://hcr.clarivate.com/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://hcr.clarivate.com/resources/archived-lists/|title=Archived HCR Lists|website=Hcr.clarivate.com|accessdate=2 March 2019|archive-date=20 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190420162744/https://hcr.clarivate.com/resources/archived-lists/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Al Momani was honored by King [[Abdullah II Bin Al Hussein]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://kingabdullah.jo/en/news/king-attends-opening-world-science-forum-2017|title=King attends opening of World Science Forum 2017 - King Abdullah II Official Website|website=Kingabdullah.jo|accessdate=2 March 2019}}</ref> among the Jordanian Stars of Science for his contributions to his field of specialization during the [[World Science Forum]] in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://english.alghad.com/prints/1925252-King-Awards-Participating-Jordanian-Scientists-at-WSF|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20180520124130/http://english.alghad.com/prints/1925252-King-Awards-Participating-Jordanian-Scientists-at-WSF|archive-date = 2018-05-20|title = الصفحة الرئيسية}}</ref>

==Qualifications and positions==
* [[B.Sc.]] in mathematics in 1984 from [[Yarmouk University]].
* [[Ph.D.]] in mathematics in 1991 from [[University of Wales]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ju.edu.jo/Lists/InTheSpotLight/Disp.aspx?ID=596|title=Prof. Shaher Momani - The University of Jordan - InTheSpotLight|website=Ju.edu.jo|accessdate=2 March 2019}}</ref>
* [[Islamic World Academy of Sciences]] fellowship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iasworld.org/prof-shaher-momani/|title=IAS » Prof. Shaher Momani|website=Iasworld.org|accessdate=2 March 2019|archive-date=13 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413060953/http://www.iasworld.org/prof-shaher-momani/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Dean of the Faculty of Science at university of Jordan between 2014-2016.
* Dean of Academic Research at university of Jordan between 2016-2018.
* Member of [[Princess Sumaya University for Technology]] board of trustees.<ref name="auto"/>
* [[Jordan Scientific Research Support Fund]] member between 2010-2012.
* Member at the [[editorial board]] of ''[[The Jordanian Journal of Mathematics and Statistics]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://journals.yu.edu.jo/jjms/EditorialBoard.html|title=JJMS Information|website=Journals.yu.edu.jo|accessdate=2 March 2019}}</ref>
* Editor in chief of University of Jordan ''Dirasat'' journal.
* Chairman of the Department of Mathematics at the University of Jordan between 2012 and 2014.
* Chairman of the Department of Mathematics at [[Mutah University]] between 1994 and 1995.

==Awards==
* The Order of [[King Abdullah II]] for Excellence of the Second Class for scientific research.
* [[ISESCO]] Science Prize in 2008.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.isesco.org.ma/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/ISESCO-Science-Prizes.pdf|title=List of ISESCO Science and Technology Prizes laureates from 1997 to 2014|website=Isesco.org.ma|accessdate=2 March 2019}}</ref>
* Ali Mango Distinguished Researcher Prize in 2016.
* [[TWAS Prize]] for the Young Scientists in 2000.
* Researcher Prize in Jordan in 2012.
* Distinguished Researcher Prize at [[The University of Jordan]].
